load_jepa_model: load a pretrained JEPA model from an asset card or model name using get_jepa_model_hub().load_model()
create_jepa_model: create a new JEPA model instance with a custom JepaConfig using get_jepa_model_hub().create_new_model()
list_jepa_archs: list all supported JEPA model architectures using get_jepa_model_hub().get_archs()
get_jepa_arch_config: get the configuration for a specific JEPA architecture using get_jepa_model_hub().get_arch_config()
iterate_jepa_cards: iterate over all available JEPA model asset cards using get_jepa_model_hub().iter_cards()
